description: Incoterms 2020 explainer — Plain-language Incoterms 2020 obligations for a trade term. Give term= (EXW, FCA, FAS, FOB, CFR, CIF, CPT, CIP, DAP, DPU, DDP; several comma-separated to compare; ALL to list) and optional mode=container. Returns who arranges and pays main carriage, insurance duty (CIF clause C vs CIP clause A), export and import clearance, loading and unloading, where risk transfers, pitfalls, how to write the term, container advice (FOB to FCA, CIF to CIP) and a side-by-side comparison. Maps retired terms (DAT, DDU) to current ones. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: logistics_incoterms
